note: Diagnostic probe: the Stage-C yes/no classifier is fit on all 34 yes/no items (not held out) using bm25 retrieval features, then each question is negated ('Is it NOT the case that ...?') and re-scored. It measures whether the classifier's decision flips when a question's logical polarity is negated. A LOGICALLY SOUND classifier should flip on (nearly) every item, since negating the question negates the correct answer; a low flip rate means the classifier is tracking surface lexical cues rather than semantic polarity.
